name: Afrodescendant Ali engagement paths

commercial_boundary.handoff: When the buyer problem becomes organizational decision, commercial capture, systematization, automation, or measurement, route to Ascend Global Ventures.

engagement_paths.name: Public Narrative / Documentary Engagement
engagement_paths.buyer_problem: Something important needs to be documented, explained, preserved, or communicated publicly.
engagement_paths.buyer_receives: A defined story angle, source plan, narrative structure, agreed public result, and supporting handoff package.
engagement_paths.buyer_provides: Access to people, places, archives, source material, permissions, and timely feedback.
engagement_paths.role: Ali-owned public narrative and supporting production.

engagement_paths.name: Research / Verification Engagement
engagement_paths.buyer_problem: A subject, claim, or history needs source review, reconstruction, verification, or Black World context.
engagement_paths.buyer_receives: An evidence trail and briefing, memo, dossier, or public explanation that distinguishes established, uncertain, and unresolved findings.
engagement_paths.buyer_provides: The question, context, source leads, intended audience, and decision or publication context.
engagement_paths.role: Ali-owned understanding and evidence work. Briefs, reports, memos, and dossiers are delivery formats.

engagement_paths.name: Public Presence Clarity Engagement
engagement_paths.buyer_problem: People need to understand who we are, trust us, find us, and know what to do next.
engagement_paths.buyer_receives: Clarified positioning, message architecture, public-facing structure, proof presentation, and inquiry pathway.
engagement_paths.buyer_provides: Current materials, offer or project details, audience knowledge, proof, approvals, and a realistic launch window.
engagement_paths.role: Ali-owned public-facing communication, credibility, publishing, and presence.

agv_handoff.name: Ascend Global Ventures
route_when: market entry, buyers, revenue, or commercial opportunity
trade, procurement, partnerships, or CRM/referral systems
AI, workflow, automation, organizational knowledge, or operating systems

representation_note: Human pages remain the customer-facing authority. This representation does not expose the internal 24-offer catalog as a public marketplace and does not create an autonomous action endpoint.
